# one JSON line: lower the memory request of the rome template (backup kept), then show its #SBATCH lines
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
f = "/scratch/coop/drozda/skill-slurm-julia-cuda-jacc/reference/run_job_cpu_parallel_rome.sbatch"
parts = Pair{String,String}[]
txt = read(f, String)
sb(t) = join(filter(l -> startswith(l, "#SBATCH"), split(t, "\n")), "\n")
push!(parts, "before" => sb(txt))
old = "#SBATCH --mem=240G"
if count(old, txt) == 1
    bak = f * ".bak-20261126"
    isfile(bak) || cp(f, bak)
    write(f, replace(txt, old => "#SBATCH --mem=100G"))
    push!(parts, "edit" => "changed 1 line, backup " * bak)
else
    push!(parts, "edit" => "no edit: the line '$old' was found $(count(old, txt)) times")
end
push!(parts, "after" => sb(read(f, String)))
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
